objective: Require specialist gains to survive on unseen tasks before any learning claim or promotion.
transfer_rules: transfer tasks must be created and frozen before specialist training outputs are inspected
no overlap with baseline or training examples
no semantic near-duplicates intentionally derived from training items
same evaluation rubric family but novel problem instances
raw outputs immutable and SHA256 verified
claim_rule: A training-set or baseline-only gain is not evidence of generalization.
